class.name: RailVehicleRenderingServer
class.brief_description: Draws rail vehicles: their models, their running gear and the detail they are drawn in.
class.description: A [VehicleRenderingServer] of rail vehicles: drawn where [RailVehicleServer] places them on their track, their bogies turned towards their own track and their wheels by the distance rolled ([RailVehicleAppearance]). A plugin's renderer derives from it, animates the rest of its own vehicles and stands in its place under the same singleton; without a plugin the models are drawn only.
